en: Colorized vintage view over a lakeside village surrounded by high mountains. In the foreground are tightly packed red‑tiled houses and a small church with a red roof and bell tower. The lake dominates the middle of the image, with steep mountains and a small peninsula or island in the distance. At the top center the word "Molveno" is printed, and on a building or sign in the lower left appears the text "EL MOLVENO".
